Class DrawBufferManager

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.granite.DrawBufferManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class DrawBufferManager extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Manages dynamic and streaming GPU buffers.

For streaming buffers: use persistent mapped host-visible buffers for Vulkan and OpenGL 4.4; use mutable buffer and CPU staging buffer for OpenGL 4.3 and below.

    • flush

      public boolean flush(Consumer<@SharedPtr Task> outTasks, it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.objects.ObjectArrayList<@SharedPtr Resource> outResourceRefs)
      Finalizes all buffers and transfers ownership of them to given list. Returns true on success and false if hasMappingFailed() returns true.

      Regardless of success or failure, the DrawBufferManager is reset to a valid initial state for recording buffer data for the next Recording.

      Parameters:
      outTasks - receive tasks
      outResourceRefs - receive ownership of resources
